findings.title: Monitor context discards schedule_type display conversion
findings.body: In get_monitor_environment_context a copy of monitor.config is made in `config` and `config['schedule_type']` is replaced with get_schedule_type_display(), but the returned dict uses `monitor_environment.monitor.config` instead of `config`. The conversion is therefore dead code and callers always receive the raw schedule_type value in the occurrence context.

findings.title: IndexError when previous_checkins window is empty
findings.body: In try_incident_threshold `starting_checkin = previous_checkins[0]` is accessed without checking length. If the DB query returns no rows, or failure_issue_threshold is 0 or negative so the slice is empty, this raises IndexError and crashes mark_failed processing instead of creating or skipping the incident gracefully.

findings.title: get_failure_reason mishandles empty or unmapped statuses
findings.body: get_failure_reason filters check-ins to HUMAN_FAILURE_STATUS_MAP and only handles the single-count case. If failed_checkins is empty or contains only statuses like OK or in-progress that are filtered out, status_counts is empty, the single-item branch is skipped, and the plural branch formats an empty list into '%(problem_checkins)s check-ins detected', producing malformed evidence such as ' check-ins detected' for the monitor issue.
